description: Audit up to 20 dependencies in one call: paste a package.json or requirements.txt, or list packages (npm:lodash@4.17.15, pypi:requests@2.19.0; npm, PyPI, Go, Cargo, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems). Each gets known vulnerabilities and malware reports (OSV) with CVE, severity and fixing version, latest version, deprecation, licenses and an ok/upgrade/avoid verdict; plus a summary. Data: deps.dev and OSV.dev (CC-BY 4.0). Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

ecosystem.description: Default ecosystem for entries without a prefix

manifest.description: package.json or requirements.txt contents, instead of packages

packages.description: Comma- or newline-separated ecosystem:name@version (version optional: latest)

name: packages_check
